lesson.title: Part 2 and essay structure
lesson.focus: the Part 2 notes method, planning a Task 2 essay in five minutes

steps.title: Part 1 questions
steps.intro: Read every question once before you answer any of them.

groups.name: Hometown
questions: What do you like most about it?
Has it changed much since you were a child?
Would you like to live there in the future?
What is the most interesting part of your town?

groups.name: Weekends
questions: What do you usually do at the weekend?
Do you prefer to spend weekends alone or with friends?
Did you do anything special last weekend?
What would you like to do more often at weekends?

steps.title: Sample answer
steps.intro: Read it twice: once for meaning, once for the phrases.
paragraphs: I come from a mid-sized town in the Fergana Valley, which is known for its orchards and its slow pace of life. What I like most is that everyone seems to know each other, so there is a real sense of community.
It has changed a great deal since I was a child. New apartment blocks have sprung up on the outskirts, and the old bazaar has been renovated, although it has kept its character.

cards.back:
a calm, unhurried way of living
Example: My town has a slow pace of life.

the feeling that people belong together and help each other
Example: There is a real sense of community here.

to appear suddenly
Example: New cafes have sprung up everywhere.

to stay the same in spirit after changes
Example: The bazaar has kept its character.

to relax after work or study
Example: I unwind by walking in the park.

steps.title: Your written answers
steps.label: Speaking written answers
steps.prompt: Write an answer to each question by hand. Highlight every new phrase you used. Photograph the pages.

steps.title: Record your answers
steps.label: Speaking recordings
steps.prompt: One answer per question, 20 to 40 seconds each. Do not read from your notes.
questions: What do you like most about it?
Has it changed much since you were a child?
What do you usually do at the weekend?
Did you do anything special last weekend?

steps.title: Review the lesson
steps.text: Go back over the Part 2 notes method and the five-minute essay plan from today's lesson.

steps.title: Upload your notes
steps.label: Writing lesson notes
steps.prompt: Photograph the notes you took in the lesson.

steps.title: Watch the video walkthrough
steps.text: Reading marathon, one passage. Pause and think before each answer is explained.

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Make sure you understand every question and why each answer is right.
